description:
Programme or Project Overview

The University of Twente Scholarship (UTS) is a selective award for excellent international students admitted to a qualifying master's programme at the University of Twente in the Netherlands. The scholarship rewards academic achievement and is offered in combination with the university's admission process. For the 2027-28 intake the award ranges from EUR 3,000 to EUR 22,000 for one year, and students who perform well can request an extension for a second year of their master's.

Only students who have first been (conditionally) admitted to a qualifying UT master's programme can be considered, so the scholarship application runs alongside or after programme admission. Candidates are assessed on their study results, motivation and the fit with the chosen master's. The scholarship is a tuition and living-cost contribution rather than a full salary, and it is often combined with other funding sources by successful applicants.

Rounds and procedure

The scholarship is offered in two application rounds per year, aligned with the university's admission cycles: the first round closes on 1 February 2027 and the second on 1 May 2027, with earlier rounds generally giving the best chance for visa and housing planning. Applicants register through the university's scholarship application module after receiving their study admission number, and selection results are communicated by the faculty before enrolment. Because the UTS is competitive, candidates are advised to submit complete documents, a strong motivation and evidence of academic excellence in the first round where possible.

Highlights

  • EUR 3,000 - 22,000 award for one year, extendable to a second year
  • For qualifying master's programmes at the University of Twente
  • Requires (conditional) admission to a UT master's first
  • Two application rounds: 1 February and 1 May 2027
  • Merit-based selection on results and motivation
  • Combinable with other funding where rules allow

About University of Twente

University of Twente is a public university in Enschede, the Netherlands. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes combining engineering, technology and social sciences. Its research connects technical innovation with human and societal needs, including work in digital systems, health and sustainability, supported by collaboration with industry and academic partners.
